title: L9 Generated Data Provenance
description: Shared provenance contract (law §10.2, §12). Referenced by the subagent data packet and every generated data unit so evidence is traced identically wherever it appears.

evidenceRef.title: Evidence reference
evidenceRef.description: One inspectable evidence reference (law §10.2): a repository path, a `sha256:<hex>` file hash, a `commit:<sha>` reference, a `test:<id>` result, a `command:<argv>` receipt, an `artifact:<id>` typed artifact, a `probe:<name>` runtime probe, a `ci:<id>` result, a `review:<id>` finding, or a `source:<uri>` governed external source.

provenanceBlock.title: Provenance block
provenanceBlock.description: Aggregate provenance for a packet: what was consumed, what evidence was produced, what was inspected, and what was executed.
